source.label: Sound
source.description: What does the track start with?

drums.label: Drums
drums.description: A beat made of kick, snare & hi-hats – just click the boxes.

melody.label: Melody
melody.description: Notes from a scale – nothing can sound wrong.

chords.label: Chords
chords.description: A chord progression that is voiced nicely for you.

custom.label: Your own chords
custom.hint: Replaces the choice above. Each chord lasts one bar.

sample.label: Sample
sample.description: Plays any sound from the Strudel sample library.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.hint: Sounds: tabla, elec, perc, glitch, bass, ambi, vinyl, misc, piano and the drums bd, sd, cp, hh, oh, rim. “~” = rest, “*2” = twice, “:3” = variation 3.

code.label: Code
code.description: Free Strudel code for anything blocks can't do (yet).

code.label: Strudel expression
code.hint: An expression that results in a pattern – just like in the Strudel REPL.

slow.label: Slower
slow.description: Stretches the pattern over several bars.

firstOf.label: Variation
firstOf.description: Changes every nth bar – adds some variety.

degrade.label: Random
degrade.description: Randomly leaves out notes – sounds more alive.

jux.label: Stereo mirror
jux.description: Normal on the left, backwards on the right – a very wide sound.

width.label: Width
width.hint: 100 % = fully left and right, less = closer together.

sometimes.label: Sometimes
sometimes.description: Every now and then a note gets changed.

euclid.label: Euclid rhythm
euclid.description: Spreads a number of hits as evenly as possible – rhythms like this are found all over the world.

steps.label: Steps
steps.hint: Into how many steps the bar is divided. 3 of 8 = Cuban tresillo.

rotation.label: Shift
rotation.hint: Moves the rhythm along by a few steps.

off.label: Offset copy
off.description: Plays a copy a little later – optionally higher or lower. Great for melodies.

echo.label: Repeats
echo.description: Repeats every note a few times, quieter each time – like an echo made of real notes.

feedback.label: Volume of repeats
feedback.hint: How loud each repeat stays compared to the one before. 100 % = no fading.

chunk.label: Part by part
chunk.description: Splits the bar into parts and changes one of them per bar – one after the other.

iter.label: Rotate
iter.description: Starts each bar one part later – the pattern rolls through.

palindrome.label: Back and forth
palindrome.description: Every second bar plays backwards – forwards, backwards, forwards …

swing.label: Swing
swing.description: Delays every second note a little – gives a bouncy, groovy feel.

linger.label: Repeat start
linger.description: Repeats just the beginning of the bar – a typical DJ effect.

segment.label: Into steps
segment.description: Turns long notes and smooth movements into evenly spaced steps.

shuffle.label: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Cuts the bar into parts and plays them in random order.

mask.label: Mute pattern
mask.description: Switches parts of the pattern on and off – for breaks and build-ups.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.hint: 1 = play, 0 = silent. <…> = one value per bar: “<1 1 1 [1 0]>” mutes the second half of every 4th bar.

transpose.label: Transpose
transpose.description: Shifts all notes up or down. Drums and samples sound higher or lower.

semitones.label: Semitones
semitones.hint: 12 = one octave, 7 = a fifth. Negative = lower.

scaleTranspose.label: Scale steps
scaleTranspose.description: Moves the notes up or down within the scale – always stays in key. Only for Melody.

steps.label: Steps
steps.hint: 2 = a third higher, 7 = one octave (in 7-note scales).

arp.label: Arpeggio
arp.description: Plays chords note by note instead of all at once.

custom.label: Your own order
custom.hint: Numbers of the chord notes, 0 = lowest. Replaces the choice above.

superimpose.label: Layer
superimpose.description: Puts a copy at a different pitch on top – sounds fuller.

vib.label: Vibrato
vib.description: Makes the pitch wobble – like a singer or a violin.

chop.label: Chop
chop.description: Cuts every sample into small pieces – for glitchy, grainy sounds. For samples.

striate.label: Interleave
striate.description: Cuts the samples into pieces and plays them interleaved across the bar. For samples.

slice.label: Slices
slice.description: Cuts a sample (e.g. a drum loop) into equal slices and plays them in a new order.

loopAt.label: Fit to bars
loopAt.description: Speeds a sample up or slows it down so it lasts exactly this many bars – for loops.

lpf.label: Filter (muffled)
lpf.description: Takes away the highs – makes the sound softer and darker.

hpf.label: Filter (thin)
hpf.description: Takes away the bass – makes room in the mix.

sweep.label: Filter sweep
sweep.description: The filter opens and closes by itself – a classic.

filterEnv.label: Filter envelope
filterEnv.description: The filter opens briefly on every note – the classic “wow” of synth basses.

cutoff.label: Brightness
cutoff.hint: How bright it is while the filter is closed.

amount.label: Opening
amount.hint: How far the filter opens. Negative = it closes instead.

room.label: Reverb
room.description: Room sound – from a small bedroom to a cathedral.

delay.label: Echo
delay.description: Repeats the sound, getting quieter each time.

pan.label: Panning
pan.description: Moves the sound to the left or right.

adsr.label: Envelope
adsr.description: How quickly a note fades in and out.

crush.label: Bitcrusher
crush.description: Makes the sound crunchy like old video games.

coarse.label: Lo-fi
coarse.description: Lowers the sample rate – sounds grainy and old. Works best in Chrome and Edge.

vowel.label: Vowel
vowel.description: Makes the sound “talk” like a voice saying a, e, i, o or u.

tremolo.label: Tremolo
tremolo.description: The volume pulses in time – from a gentle wobble to hard chopping.

fm.label: FM sound
fm.description: Frequency modulation: from bells and electric pianos to metallic basses. For synth sounds.

amount.label: Brightness
amount.hint: How strongly the sound is modulated – higher = brighter and buzzier.

ratio.label: Character
ratio.hint: Whole numbers (1, 2, 3) sound musical, odd values sound metallic like bells.

decay.label: Fade
decay.hint: 0 = constant. Otherwise the brightness fades after each note starts – like a bell.

compressor.label: Compressor
compressor.description: Evens out loud and quiet parts – sounds denser and punchier.

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.hint: Everything louder than this gets compressed. Lower = more.

ratio.label: Strength
ratio.hint: 4× = anything above the threshold is squeezed to a quarter.

postgain.label: Boost
postgain.description: Turns the volume up or down after the effects – e.g. after the compressor.

sampleRange.label: Sample section
sampleRange.description: Plays only part of each sample – e.g. just the start or the tail.

cut.label: Cut off
cut.description: A new sound stops the previous one of the same group – like an open hi-hat being closed.

group.label: Group
group.hint: Tracks with the same group cut each other off.

param.label: Any parameter
param.description: Sets any Strudel sound parameter by its name – for everything that has no block of its own.

name.label: Parameter
name.hint: A Strudel name such as fmh, wtdepth or bpenv.

value.label: Value
value.hint: A number or a pattern, e.g. 0.5 or <0 0.5 1>.
